title: Add the mobile store site banner and call to action for a QR Control campaign
summary: Upload the onsite banner and add the call to action button that appears in the mobile store site carousel for a QR Control campaign, so tapping it plays the campaign on the display.
bodyMd:
For QR Control, a campaign's onsite banner and call to action appear in the mobile store site carousel once a visitor's phone is connected to the display. Tapping the call to action engages the campaign on the screen: its video plays, and the pop-up message shows on the phone.

Before you begin

  • The campaign is running on Website or Digital Signage, with the QR-Control touch-point enabled on its Campaign Brief. See Choose which campaigns appear in the campaign carousel.
  • QR Control is enabled on the display. See Enable QR Control on a display.
  • A banner image for the campaign.

Upload the onsite banner

  1. In the left navigation, select Campaigns, then select the campaign's name.
  2. Select the Creative tab, then Campaign Assets.
  3. Expand ONSITE BANNERS.
  4. Select Upload new Onsite Banner and choose the image. The banner must be uploaded before a call to action can be added.

Add the call to action

  1. Select the Call to Action sub-tab.
  2. In the touch-point drop-down, choose Mobile Store Site (QR Control).
  3. On Call To Action, switch Show CTA (Overlaid over Campaign Banner) on.
  4. Choose Button (with copy) or Button (No copy).
  5. Set the Fill Colour, Button Icon, Icon Size and Button Position.
  6. Select Mobile Preview to check the banner and button.
  7. Select Save Changes.

Verify it worked

Scan the display's QR code on a phone: it connects to the display, and the campaign appears in the carousel with its banner and the button in the position you chose. Tapping the button plays the campaign's video on the display and shows the pop-up message on the phone.
